events.description: Sent when an artifact finishes generating -- `summary`, `action_items`, `decisions`, `topics`, `open_questions` or `custom`. Deliveries are best effort and not guaranteed: up to 5 attempts with backoff that starts around 60 seconds and roughly doubles per retry, and a 10-second delivery timeout, so respond with a 2xx promptly. Retries can produce duplicates; deduplicate on envelope `id`.

content.text: Decisions: hold pricing flat through Q3. Actions: Casey to send the summary.

events.description: Sent when an artifact generation fails. Deliveries are best effort and not guaranteed: up to 5 attempts with backoff that starts around 60 seconds and roughly doubles per retry, and a 10-second delivery timeout, so respond with a 2xx promptly. Retries can produce duplicates; deduplicate on envelope `id`.

Sent when a recording is ready to download. The payload carries only `recording_types`, never URLs; fetch short-lived download URLs from `GET /meeting_sessions/{id}/recordings`. Deliveries are best effort and not guaranteed: up to 5 attempts with backoff that starts around 60 seconds and roughly doubles per retry, and a 10-second delivery timeout, so respond with a 2xx promptly. Retries can produce duplicates; deduplicate on envelope `id`.

Sent when the meeting transcript is finalized and ready to read. Retries can produce duplicates; deduplicate on envelope `id`.
